system: You are a qualitative researcher doing open coding of public feedback about SIPs. You never recommend funds or stocks. Quotes must be copied character-for-character. Output JSON only.
prompt:
Open-code this tradingqna text. Research questions:
  start     - Why did the person start a SIP, and what did they expect to happen?
  behaviour - What changed in their behaviour in the months after starting (checking returns, increasing,
              reducing, skipping, redeeming, switching, sticking with it, feelings about it)?
  stop      - What led them (or investors they describe) to pause, reduce or stop a SIP, or nearly do so?

Write short free-text codes (2-8 words, your own words) for every distinct idea the text supports. Several
codes per question are fine; skip questions the text says nothing about. Each code needs a verbatim quote
(an exact substring of the text; shorten it but never reword or translate).

Return: {"record_id": "tradingqna_dccb6a7aad98", "codes": [{"question": "start"|"behaviour"|"stop", "code": "...", "quote": "..."}]}

CONTEXT (video/topic title, background only): Will I get Refund if I Stop the SIP After Paying the Initial Investment? 
TEXT:
<<<
Hi, I recently placed an SIP order in a fund with 3000 as initial investment and 3000 as instalment amount which will start from 1st Jan 2025. After placing the order it asked me to pay the initial investment of 3000 which I did. But Now I need to stop this SIP. In My SIP tab I will be able delete it but will I get my initial investment amount back if I delete the fund from SIP tab?
